ITEM 1 | Cluster of roughly 6-7 pale-to-medium tan-pink meat pieces with light brown seared edges and a slightly glossy surface, firm and holding shape, cut into elongated strips and chunks about 4-6 cm long and 1.5-2.5 cm thick, piled together in the center-left of a large white square plate covering roughly 20% of the plate's area, with a small patch of green herb or leaf visible beneath them | 150

ITEM 2 | Small scattered green-brown flecks and a faint speck of seasoning or herb residue on the plate surface near the meat pile, dry and not saucy, covering under 1% of the plate | 1
